body:
Ravi (PM): Quick thread after the prototype run — compact pool picker + SLO controls. Wanted to capture a few divergent notes before we lock designs. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/proto-compact-picker.png

Lena (Design): Main takeaway: compact mode is promising but the density hides whether a pool is user-pinned vs auto-recommended. Suggest a tiny pin icon for user pins and a separate outline badge for recommendations. Use tooltip text: 'Pinned by you' and 'Auto-recommended to preserve SLO'.

Marco (Eng): Backend can supply `is_pinned` + `is_auto_recommended`. API idea: `GET /pools?compact=true` returns `pools: [{id,name,gpu_type,is_pinned,is_auto_recommended,slo_score}]`. Low overhead.

Pri (Frontend): For compact rows we only have one line; so rely on icons + visually-hidden labels. I'll add `aria-label="Pool A — pinned"` when pinned. Also keyboard flow: Tab should focus the whole row and Enter opens detail; keyboard shortcut `p` to toggle pin when the row has focus could be useful. Thoughts?

Noa (Accessibility): Keyboard shortcut sounds good but needs discoverability. Add a help tooltip (Shift+?/Keyboard) that lists `p` for pin when picker is open. Also ensure icon-only buttons have `aria-label`. For the color sparkline, don't use red/green alone; add `title` attr with text like 'SLO trend: falling'.

Lena (Design): Copy variants for the recommendation badge: short: 'Recommended' vs shorter 'Recd'. Prefer full 'Recommended' in compact mode? Might be too wide. Maybe abbreviated 'Rec' with hover text showing full phrase.

Ravi (PM): I'd rather avoid cryptic abbreviations for first-time users. Use 'Rec' only if space forces it; otherwise 'Recommended'. We'll test.

Marco (Eng): Another signal idea: include a compact two-letter GPU chip badge (e.g., A100 -> 'A1') to help scanning. We can compute that easily from gpu_type; no backend change needed.

Pri (Frontend): UX note: when the user adjusts min/max from the picker, show inline preview of estimated QPS and cost delta. For compact view, keep it minimal: e.g., 'Est: +6 qps · +$0.50/hr'. That ties directly to their mental model.

Lena (Design): Let's show cost delta in smaller type inline, and on hover expand to a micro-popup with per-day/per-month figures. Microcopy: 'Estimated impact: +$0.50/hr (+$12/day)'. Keep tone neutral.

Noa (Accessibility): Ensure the micro-popup is keyboard dismissible (Esc) and that its content is read by screen readers when it appears (role="dialog" with aria-modal=false for non-blocking). Also ensure the cost string uses currency formatting accessible to screen readers (e.g., 'twelve dollars per day').

Marco (Eng): For telemetry, we'll emit events: `pool_picker.change` with `from_min,from_max,to_min,to_max,estimated_cost_delta_cents`. Backend can supply `estimated_cost_delta_cents` on preview endpoints.

Pri (Frontend): One awkward case: recommended pools sometimes flip rapidly during allocation churn, which confuses users. Propose a grace window: only show 'Recommended' if the allocator has been tagging the pool for >= 30s. Marco can we get a `recommendation_stable_for_seconds` field?

Marco (Eng): Yes, we can return `recommendation_stable_for_seconds`. We'll set server-side threshold at 30s but keep the field so clients can respect it.

Lena (Design): Visual affordance for unstable recommendations: if <30s show a dotted badge and tooltip 'New recommendation — stabilizing'. If stable, solid badge 'Recommended'.

Ravi (PM): Accessibility + copy: for the SLO slider label propose two lines: top 'Target latency (ms)' and second line small: 'Lower ⟶ faster, higher cost'. Keep exact phrasing short. Noa, any objections?

Noa (Accessibility): That works. Ensure the slider announces both label and hint as `aria-describedby`. Also provide `aria-live` updates for the estimated QPS/cost when slider changes.

Pri (Frontend): I will implement `aria-describedby` IDs and update the live region. Also will make the slider step 10ms increments and expose `aria-valuetext` like '150 milliseconds, near recommended'.

Lena (Design): One last visual: add a subtle inline mini-sparkline (3px tall) to the right of each row to hint at SLO trend. Use saturation rather than hue change to indicate severity, and pair with an icon for extreme cases.

Marco (Eng): We can provide `slo_trend_sample` as 3 floats [-1..1] representing directionality; client maps to sparkline. We'll cap precision to reduce payload.

Ravi (PM): Summary & action items: Lena — update compact mocks with pin vs recommended badges, chip abbreviation, inline cost copy, and unstable vs stable recommendation states. Marco — add `is_pinned,is_auto_recommended,recommendation_stable_for_seconds,slo_trend_sample,estimated_cost_delta_cents` to preview/search endpoints. Pri — keyboard shortcut `p`, aria labels for rows, compact toast/micro-popup for cost estimates. Noa — do a quick a11y pass on keyboard help and slider live regions. Aim: updated mocks + frontend PR by Wed.

deploy-bot: Preview build for branch `feat/compact-pool-picker`: https://deploy.preview/feat/compact-pool-picker (auto)
